# Subway Seat for Shiki

The VS Code theme repackaged for Shiki, so highlighted code on the web matches the editor exactly.

[Shiki](https://shiki.style) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/shiki/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.json`](subway-seat.json) | `your project, e.g. themes/subway-seat.json` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.json`](subway-seat-tunnel.json) | `your project, e.g. themes/subway-seat-tunnel.json` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.json`](subway-seat-enamel.json) | `your project, e.g. themes/subway-seat-enamel.json` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in your build script (Astro, VitePress, Next.js and others take the same theme object):

```typescript
import { codeToHtml } from "shiki";
import theme from "./subway-seat.json" with { type: "json" };

const html = await codeToHtml(code, { lang: "ts", theme });
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in your build script (Astro, VitePress, Next.js and others take the same theme object):

```typescript
import { codeToHtml } from "shiki";
import theme from "./subway-seat-tunnel.json" with { type: "json" };

const html = await codeToHtml(code, { lang: "ts", theme });
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in your build script (Astro, VitePress, Next.js and others take the same theme object):

```typescript
import { codeToHtml } from "shiki";
import theme from "./subway-seat-enamel.json" with { type: "json" };

const html = await codeToHtml(code, { lang: "ts", theme });
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `your project, e.g. themes/subway-seat.json`.
- Delete `your project, e.g. themes/subway-seat-tunnel.json`.
- Delete `your project, e.g. themes/subway-seat-enamel.json`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
